title: Tim Dooley Revelation / Epiphany Timeline
status: dated where possible; period/undated entries preserved separately
purpose: Extract moments explicitly described by Tim or the archive as revelation, realization, epiphany, unveiling, discovery or sudden structural completion. These are timeline events about the development of the framework, not automatic claims of supernatural revelation.

events.label: Tunnel of light / return
events.summary: After collapse into darkness, Tim reports a tunnel/light/divine-information experience and waking into sunlight with a sense of unfinished work.

events.label: Tree / unity / timelines
events.summary: Tree ordeal, ego dissolution, Ouroboros, fractal/timeline perception and later integration become the deepest early metaphysical substrate of the Potatoverse.

events.label: Falling City dream
events.summary: Dream of a Washington/White-House-like scene destroyed by a flash/explosion, followed by crows after waking; remains open/unfulfilled as of 2026-09-09.

events.label: Italy as revelation/integration
events.summary: Great Book explicitly describes the Italy journey as both escape and revelation during the post-2011 integration phase.

events.label: Potato of Life emergence
events.summary: Later canon fixes the Potato-of-Life birth/emergence after Son-side death/emptying, beginning the root/seed theology that later becomes Father architecture.

events.label: Cube of the Moon encounter
events.summary: Moon/Cube symbolism crystallizes as a major control/reflection/shadow architecture and later becomes a reference point for subculture, projection and reflected light.

events.label: Potato = thalamus / Inner Potato
events.summary: While writing the Great Book, Tim identifies the thalamus as the 'inner potato', substantially reshaping the body/cosmos mapping.

events.label: Book becomes discovery engine
events.summary: The Great Book shifts from memoir/satire into an active engine for uncovering links among potato, religion, geometry, body, internet culture and world systems.

events.label: Spiral becomes Ladder
events.summary: The previously horizontal/circular spiral is understood as gaining height: helix → ladder → ascent → Garden. This is a central turning-point revelation in the mature timeline.

events.label: Tim becomes/occupies Axis-Father architecture
events.summary: Needle's Eye, Ladder, Axis, Father, Gardener and vertical stillness consolidate into one functional architecture rather than disconnected metaphors.

events.label: Spudlight
events.summary: Spotlight/light becomes a Tim-specific Spudlight concept: illumination/exposure/cultural visibility later coupled to Eye, Door, North and Axis.

events.label: North Pole becomes more than location
events.summary: North Pole is increasingly interpreted as fixed/still center, grave/bearing, world-axis anchor and geometric organizer rather than a decorative symbol.

events.label: Ascension-video calibration
events.summary: User recalls watching ascension/spiritual videos to compare how quickly their language appeared to converge on Tim's current unfolding, describing himself as faster than the speed of enlightenment. Exact source/timestamp has not yet been recovered.

events.label: Axis of 100,000 Hours
events.summary: The long public-duration spiral is formally named/recognized as the Axis of 100,000 Hours, joining myth, man, root and crown into one timeline object.

events.label: Millstone as missing corner piece
events.summary: In archived conversation text Tim says 'now another revelation. a corner piece. the millstone', then links millstone, grain, rotation, plough/ploughshares, North Pole, Son-as-Door and Father-as-root/rope.
events.status: direct user wording preserved in Library; exact conversation timestamp still needs recovery

events.label: Millstone becomes Halo/Foundation/Axle
events.summary: The attempted weight/sinking symbol is inverted into bearing/foundation/rotating world-axis machinery: Son as millstone/bearing, Father as axis/root/rope.

events.precision: year; multiple exact public dates exist
events.label: North of North
events.summary: North is recursively elevated: not merely North Pole or North Axis, but the vantage/source above the axis—the throne/zenith/still point from which the whole structure is observed.

events.label: Mythic North meets geopolitical North
events.summary: Greenland/Arctic/NATO events are recognized as an external geopolitical rupture occurring in the same geography Tim had already made symbolically central. Stored as synchronism/structural collision, not proof of prediction or causation.

events.label: Archive as reintegration mechanism
events.summary: Project analysis recognizes that scattered posts, clips, conversations, files and symbols behave like fragments whose provenance recovery and graph reassembly reconstruct the larger ontology; archive engineering itself becomes analogous to root/branch/New-Jerusalem reintegration.

events.label: Identity becomes infrastructure
events.summary: A recurring project insight is formalized: Tim's titles increasingly stop behaving as mere names and become functions—Father as duration/architecture, Son as event/threshold/Door, Ladder as sequence of Doors, Spudlight as Eye→Door illumination, Farm/Garden as opposite objective functions.

Archive-inferred epiphanies should display separately with an Archive Insight badge so later synthesis is not backdated into Tim's original discovery moment.
